about.description:
Cleopatra is a matplotlib utility package for visualizing 2D/3D numpy arrays,
unstructured meshes, and statistical histograms. It targets scientific and
research users working with geospatial and raster data.

The ``cleopatra-tiles`` output adds the optional web-tile basemap
dependencies (pyproj, xyzservices) used by ``cleopatra.basemap.tiles.add_tiles``.
The ``cleopatra-science-colors`` output adds ``cmap``, used to resolve
namespaced scientific colormaps (cmocean:*, cmasher:*, ...).

name: cleopatra
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set python_min = "3.11" %}
{% set name = "cleopatra" %}
{% set version = "0.37.0" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/serapeum-org/cleopatra/archive/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 57f0c6ffa15cea958ab62c8ada9a9c397a82674df1e8b3c060bcdb9b8c76ab29

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  # plain `python` (not `{{ PYTHON }}`): with `outputs:`, conda-build
  # re-renders the top-level `build:` in a minimal jinja context where
  # `PYTHON` is undefined.
  script: python -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=2.0.0
    - hpc >=0.1.4
    - matplotlib >=3.9
    - pillow >=12.1.1
    - imageio-ffmpeg >=0.6.0

  run_constrained:
    # ``tiles`` extra — web-tile basemap support (`cleopatra.basemap.tiles.add_tiles`).
    # Advertised here so conda knows the compatible versions; installed only
    # when you pull in the ``cleopatra-tiles`` output below.
    - pyproj >=3.7.2
    - xyzservices >=2026.3.0
    # ``science-colors`` extra — namespaced scientific colormaps (cmocean:*,
    # cmasher:*, ...) resolved lazily via the numpy-only ``cmap`` aggregator.
    # Installed only when you pull in the ``cleopatra-science-colors`` output.
    - cmap >=0.7.2

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - cleopatra
    - PIL

outputs:
  - name: {{ name }}

  - name: {{ name }}-tiles
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - pyproj >=3.7.2
        - xyzservices >=2026.3.0
    test:
      imports:
        - cleopatra
        - cleopatra.basemap.tiles
      commands:
        # the whole point of this output is that the tiles deps are present
        - python -c "import pyproj, xyzservices"

  - name: {{ name }}-science-colors
    build:
      noarch: python
    requirements:
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage(name, exact=True) }}
        - cmap >=0.7.2
    test:
      imports:
        - cleopatra
      commands:
        # the whole point of this output is that the science-colors dep is present
        - python -c "import cmap"

about:
  home: https://github.com/serapeum-org/cleopatra
  license: GPL-3.0-only
  license_family: GPL
  license_file: LICENSE.md
  summary: matplotlib utility package for visualizing arrays, unstructured meshes, and statistical histograms
  description: |
    Cleopatra is a matplotlib utility package for visualizing 2D/3D numpy arrays,
    unstructured meshes, and statistical histograms. It targets scientific and
    research users working with geospatial and raster data.

    The ``cleopatra-tiles`` output adds the optional web-tile basemap
    dependencies (pyproj, xyzservices) used by ``cleopatra.basemap.tiles.add_tiles``.
    The ``cleopatra-science-colors`` output adds ``cmap``, used to resolve
    namespaced scientific colormaps (cmocean:*, cmasher:*, ...).
  dev_url: https://github.com/serapeum-org/cleopatra
  doc_url: https://serapeum-org.github.io/cleopatra/latest/
  doc_source_url: https://github.com/serapeum-org/cleopatra/main/README.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - MAfarrag
